history.content: Hey Nova, I was thinking of 3D printing, a sort of nail that is hollow, but that you screw onto the beach, so into the sand, and since it's hollow it has a cap where you can put stuff inside and then leave it inside and cover it with a towel. Do you think how much time do you think this will take to print?

I don't have experience with 3D printing or sand projects, but I can help you brainstorm! If you're looking to create a hollow nail that's hollow, you'd need a 3D printer with a sand extruder or a manual method. The time would depend on the complexity, but it could take a few hours to an day. Let me know if you want specific steps or materials!
